hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook managing token launches ("publiphi") with a timed fair launch period, scheduled pool opening, optional Merkle whitelist, and fee distribution across creators, protocol, referrers, and swappers. During the fair launch window, sells are blocked and buys are filled from a hook-managed position; after it closes, standard AMM swaps apply with hook-captured fees.
